title: Cardiac function testing
description: A cardiac function testing evaluates how effectively your heart pumps and circulates blood. Your doctor uses these results to diagnose heart problems, check medication effectiveness, or clear you for surgery. The tests are painless, non-invasive, and typically take 30-60 minutes. You'll return home the same day feeling completely normal. This type of procedure can be performed various ways, including ecg and functional cardiac testing, and the cost may vary depending on the specific approach or service provided.
